text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I must find a breakthrough, and soon...
choice_data_list: Let's take our time and work through it step by step.
Let's get ready for the next race right away!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Clear the challenges... one by one.
...Build it up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that...
eventually—I should be able to fulfill my duty."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Thank you for making me realize that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. First—I will review today's race—and identify the areas for improvement.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Without fail—by the next race, I will—
overcome these issues.
